e: A drug smuggling case is thwarted by police at Luang Prabang International Airport involving a private jet from Malaysia planning to transport methamphetamine to the Philippines. This leads to a joint investigation by authorities in Malaysia and the Philippines after a Filipino politician is suspected to have been involved.
Seven people are reported trapped inside a cave in Xaisomboun province following flash floods.
Bokeo International Airport is officially opened.
Longstanding MP Valy Vetsaphong announces her withdrawal from the 2026 Laotian parliamentary election.
A massive sinkhole emerges in the village of Thongmang in Xaythany district, Vientiane Prefecture, leaving four people missing and presumed dead.
